title: Double Drip Strawberry Banana Waffle Shortfill E-Liquid 50ml
description: Sweet, decadent and utterly irresistible, this delicious e-liquid from Double Drip is unique blend of sweet, succulent strawberries and creamy bananas, layered over a warm, comforting base of freshly-baked waffles. A perfect combination of fruit and pastry your taste buds will never get enough of. These short fill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength, and typically adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml will give you 60ml of 3mg liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the short fill bottle well. We also offer a range of 18mg nicotine-containing e-liquid shots in a variety of VG percentage strengths to ensure you find a perfect match to suit your taste. Double Drip Coil Sauce E-Liquid is a high-quality vape juice brand proudly manufactured right here in the United Kingdom. Browse the entire Double Drip range and find the perfect juice for your e-cigarette setup. Double Drip is available in a variety of formulations to suit a range of kits, including sub ohm (high-VG), 50/50 e-liquid , nicotine salt vape juice , and 50ml shortfills for use with starter vape kits , high-powered e cig kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
